sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Midas of the Mountains is another name for the fairy god Midir. Monaghan's encyclopedia points the reader from this name to the Midir entry. In local folklore near Brí Léith in County Longford, the giant Midas lives in a hidden palace and steals the children who pass by. That giant is the same figure as the fairy god Midir.
